blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce Gen4P, a unified framework for recovering 4D geometry and motion from monocular video. We show that a pretrained video generator can be repurposed into a feed-forward 4D perceiver without iterative denoising. Building on on-demand querying, Gen4P processes clean video latents in a single encoder pass and predicts the requested 4D attributes through a lightweight cross-attention decoder. The on-demand query formulation enables flexible spatial sampling, and our proposed continuous-time queries further provide temporal flexibility. To strengthen geometric knowledge, we propose a straightforward plug-in solution by incorporating a pretrained video-depth LoRA as a frozen geometry prior, improving overall performance without adding extra trainable parameters. Gen4P achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance on tasks of 3D point tracking, video depth and camera pose estimation. Qualitative results on in-the-wild videos illustrate its capability of tracking complex motion while maintaining the delicate structure. Together, these results demonstrate the potential of video generative pretraining for unified 4D perception. See https://gen4p.github.io for more visual results.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Gen4P,从单相机视频中恢复4D几何和运动的统一框架. 我们显示,经过预先训练的视频生成器可以重新使用到向导的4D感知器,而无需迭代去诺. Gen4P在点播查询的基础上,在单个编码器通过中处理干净的视频潜伏,并通过轻量级交叉意向解码器来预测所请求的4D属性. 点播查询的制定能够灵活地进行空间取样,我们提议的连续时间查询进一步提供了时间灵活性。 为加强几何知识,我们提出一个直接的插接解决方案,将经过预先训练的视频深度LORA作为被冷冻的几何前置,改善整体性能,而不会增加额外的可训练参数. Gen4P在3D点跟踪,视频深度和相机等任务上实现最先进的或有竞争力的性能来进行估计. 现场视频的定性结果说明了它在保持微妙结构的同时跟踪复杂运动的能力. 这些结果共同表明视频基因预训对统一4D感知的潜力. 见 https://gen4p.github.io 更多视觉效果.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
We consider the problem of feed-forward full 4D reconstruction from monocular video.
A unified 4D representation of scene geometry, depth, camera poses, and 3D point trajectories provides a foundation for simulating and interacting with the physical environment.
However,
recovering such a representation remains challenging:
it requires accurately capturing both the static geometry and the dynamic motion of the scene across viewpoints and over time .
blocks.zh:
我们考虑通过单视视频进行全方位4D重建的问题。
场景几何,深度,相机姿势,以及3D点轨迹的统一4D代表,为模拟和与物理环境互动提供了基础.
不过
恢复这种代表性仍然具有挑战性:
它需要精确地捕捉静态几何和场景的动态运动,

blocks.en:
Recent advances in feed-forward reconstruction demonstrate the value of pretrained foundational vision models.
Geometry Foundation Models (GFMs),
including VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , VGGT- Ω \Omega ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , and DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) ,
build on pretrained vision models ( Oquab et al., 2023 ; Siméoni et al., 2025 ) ,
adapting them through large-scale geometric supervision.
These GFMs then provide strong geometry priors for subsequent 4D reconstruction: V-DPM ( Sucar et al., 2026 ) and 4RC ( Luo et al., 2026 ) ,
for instance, extend VGGT and DA3 to jointly recover geometry and motion.
However, geometry priors alone do not explicitly model how points should evolve over time in dynamic scenes.
blocks.zh:
近期在向前进的重建方面取得的进展表明,经过预先培训的基础远景模型很有价值。
几何基础模型,
包括VGGT(王等人,维基),VGGT-维基(王等人,2026a)和DA3(林等人,维基),
利用经过培训的视觉模型(Oquab等人,2023年;Siméoni等人,2025年),
通过大规模的几何监督来适应它们.
这些GFM随后为后来的4D重建提供了强烈的几何学前身:V-DPM(Sucar等人,2026年)和4RC(Luo等人,2026年) ,.
例如,将VGGT和DA3扩展为共同恢复几何和运动。
然而,光是几何学前科并不能明确模拟点数在动态场景中应如何随时间演变.

blocks.en:
Meanwhile,
foundational generative models offer a complementary source of priors over appearance, geometry, and motion,
by learning to synthesize images and videos ( Wan et al., 2025 ; ByteDance Seed Team, 2026 ) .
Recent studies have exploited generative priors for
2D correspondence ( Hedlin et al., 2023 ) ,
depth estimation ( Ke et al., 2024 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) ,
3D geometry recovery ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) , motion tracking ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Nam et al., 2026a ) ,
and general perception ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
However, they still address 4D perception through task-specific approaches.
Besides,
they often require dense, frame-aligned supervision, limiting their flexibility in handling arbitrary spatiotemporal video inputs.

blocks.en:
In this work,
we introduce Gen4P ,
a 4D perceiver that leverages rich priors from large-scale pretrained video generators for full 4D reconstruction.
Specifically,
Gen4P tames a multi-step video generator into a single-step feed-forward 4D perceiver.
To this end, the objective is formulated as learning a direct regression network, instead of the iterative denoising for geometric reconstruction in prior works ( Ke et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) .
Such a formulation requires only one encoder forward pass per input clip. The resulting scene tokens are then shared across queries, reducing the encoding cost over repeated 4D predictions.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,
我们介绍GEN4P,
a 4D感应器,利用大规模预先训练的视频发电机的丰富前兆进行全4D重建。
具体来说,
GEN4P将多步视频生成器驯化成单步向导4D感应器.
为此,制定的目标是学习直接回归网络,而不是以往作品中几何重建的迭代代命名(Ke等人,2024年;Jiang等人,2025年;Lu等人,2025年)。
这种配制只需要每个输入片段一个编码器前传. 由此产生的场景代号随后通过查询共享,比重复的4D预测降低编码成本.

blocks.en:
We obtain the full 4D attributes by querying the scene tokens using a lightweight cross-attention decoder.
It decouples the output sampling from pre-extracted feature grids,
allowing spatial flexibility in the output resolution.
Additionally, we introduce a continuous-time query mechanism to handle variable-length video sequences effectively.
Furthermore, we discover that a pretrained video-depth LoRA can further be incorporated as a frozen plug-in geometric prior, strengthening geometry without introducing additional trainable parameters.
blocks.zh:
我们通过使用轻量级交叉式解码器查询场景标志来获得完整的4D属性.
它将输出取样与预提取的特性网格脱钩,
允许输出分辨率的空间灵活性。
此外,我们引入了连续时间查询机制,以有效处理可变长度的视频序列。
此外,我们发现,经过预先训练的视频深度LORA可被进一步纳入一个冻结的插头几何前,加强几何,而不引入额外的可训练参数。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Feed-forward GFMs directly regress pixel-aligned geometry, from pairwise point maps ( Wang et al., 2024 ) to sequence models that use spatial memory ( Wang and Agapito, 2025 ) , recurrent scene states ( Wang et al., 2025b ) , or joint multi-view attention with multiple prediction heads ( Wang et al., 2025a ) .
Later models remove the reference view ( Wang et al., 2026c ) , accept optional geometric inputs ( Keetha et al., 2026 ) , or learn unified depth–ray targets ( Lin et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
Feed-forward GFMs直接递归像素对齐几何,从对偶点图(Wang等人,2024年)到使用空间内存的序列模型(Wang and Agapito,2025年),反复出现的场景状态(Wang等人,2025年b),或与多个预测头(Wang等人,2025年a)的联合多视图关注.
后来的模型删除了参考视图(Wang等人,2026c),接受可选几何输入(Keetha等人,2026),或学习统一的深度-射线目标(Lin等人,2025).

blocks.en:
Point Tracking in 2D and 3D. 2D point tracking has been extensively studied in both sparse and dense settings ( Doersch et al., 2022 ; Karaev et al., 2024 ; Karaev et al., 2025 ; Lai et al., 2026 ) .
3D point tracking methods lift pixels with monocular depth and iterative refinement ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) ,
improve dense long-range estimation through optimized surrogate queries ( Ngo et al., 2025b ; Ngo et al., 2025a ) , or jointly estimate geometry, camera, and object motion ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) .
GFM-based 4D perceivers represent dynamic 3D scenes through per-frame point maps ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , dynamic point maps ( Sucar et al., 2026 ) , conditional frame-wise decoding ( Luo et al., 2026 ) , or motion bases ( Lin et al., 2026 ) .
Other approaches include common-time point-map pairs ( Feng et al., 2025 ) , parametric trajectories ( Liu et al., 2026 ) , and scene flow ( Zhu et al., 2026 ; Karhade et al., 2026 ; Qian et al., 2026 ) .
Most rely on frame-aligned grid decoding, coupling output sampling and cost to spatial resolution, whereas D4RT ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) decouples prediction from predefined grids through on-demand queries.
blocks.zh:
2D和3D中的点追踪. 2D点跟踪在稀疏和密集的环境下进行了广泛的研究(Doersch等人,2022年;Karaev等人,2024年;Karaev等人,2025年;Lai等人,2026年)。
3D点跟踪方法 提升像素,具有单向深度和迭代精度(Xiao等人,2024年) ,
通过优化代位查询(Ngo等人,2025年b;Ngo等人,2025年a)或共同估算几何、相机和物体运动(Xiao等人,2025年)。
基于GFM的4D感知器通过每帧点图(张等人,2025a),动态点图(Sucar等人,2026),有条件的帧式解码(Luo等人,2026),或运动底座(Lin等人,2026)来代表动态3D场景.
其他方法包括常见时间点图对(冯等人,2025年),参数轨迹(刘等人,2026年),场景流(朱等人,2026年;卡尔哈德等人,2026年;钱等人,2026年).
多数依赖帧对齐的网格解码,将输出采样和成本与空间分辨率相配合,而D4RT(Zhang等人,2026a)则通过点播查询将预定义网格的预测脱钩.

blocks.en:
Generative Priors for Geometry and Motion. Large pretrained generators encode geometry and motion priors transferable to perception tasks ( Zhan et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) .
Image adaptations estimate depth through iterative denoising ( Ke et al., 2024 ) or single-step regression ( He et al., 2025 ) .
Video adaptations predict depth ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , point maps ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , fused point–ray maps ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , or scene flow ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) .
Feature-based trackers instead exploit internal temporal correspondences for 2D tracking ( Nam et al., 2026b ; Son et al., 2025 ) .
Recent feed-forward adaptations repurpose video generators for direct video depth regression ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , dense 3D tracking ( Nam et al., 2026a ) , or multimodal unified perception ( Wang et al., 2026b ) .
blocks.zh:
"几何与运动"的基因前传. 大型预训发电机编码几何和运动前传可转移至感知任务(Zhan等人,2024年;Huang等人,2026年).
图像适应通过迭代调试(Ke等人,2024年)或单步回归(He等人,2025年)估计深度.
视频改编预测深度(胡等人,2025年),点图(徐等人,2025年),引信点射线图(江等人,2025年),或场景流(朱等人,2026年).
基于地物的跟踪器则利用内部时间通信进行2D跟踪(Nam等人,2026b;Son等人,2025年)。
近期的Feed-forward改编视频发电机用于直接视频深度回归(Zhang等人,2026b),密集3D跟踪(Nam等人,2026a),或多式联运统一感知(Wang等人,2026b).

including 3D tracking, 3D point clouds, video depths, and camera parameters.
Instead of training a large-scale 4D geometric network from scratch, in Gen4P we repurpose a pretrained video generator p pre p_{\mathrm{pre}} as a feed-forward 4D perceiver.

As illustrated in Fig. 2 , Gen4P adopts an on-demand query-based formulation inspired by D4RT ( Sec. 3.1 ).
A lightweight decoder queries spatiotemporal features from the pretrained video generator ( Sec. 3.2.1 ) to predict 4D attributes at specified locations and times.
Since real-world videos vary in duration, a practical 4D reconstruction method should accommodate different sequence lengths. Unlike D4RT, we introduce a continuous time query ( Sec. 3.2.2 ) to enhance flexibility. We further introduce a plug-in geometry prior ( Sec. 3.3 ) to enhance geometric performance.
The training objective is described in Sec. 3.4 .

blocks.en: 3.2 Video Generators as 4D Perceivers
blocks.zh: 3.2 视频生成器为4D接收器

blocks.en:
Gen4P repurposes a video generator into a single-pass feed-forward 4D perceiver,
without multi-step denoising ( Ke et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) or noise injection ( Zhan et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) to read out diffusion features.
This formulation enables direct feature extraction while avoiding the overhead of iterative denoising.
Specifically, Gen4P consists of a video-generator-based encoder with a LoRA-adapted video DiT backbone, and a cross-attention query decoder, as described next.
blocks.zh:
Gen4P将一个视频生成器重新用于一个单路向导的4D感应器,
无需多步骤去诺(Ke等人,2024年;Jiang等人,2025年)或噪声注射(Zhan等人,2024年;Huang等人,2026年)读出扩散特征.
这种提法可以直接提取特性,同时避免迭代调音的间接作用。
具体来说,Gen4P包含一个基于视频生成器的编码器,其中包含一个LORA改编的视频DiT主干线,以及一个交叉调制的查询解码器,如下所述.

Here, the noise level σ \sigma denotes the corruption strength applied to the input video latents.

blocks.en: 3.3 Plug-in Geometry Prior
blocks.zh: 3.3 插件几何前置

blocks.en:
Recent GFM-finetuned 4D perceivers ( Sucar et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) benefit from geometry priors, which are learned through large-scale dense 3D pretraining.
In contrast, Gen4P adapts a pretrained video generator to exploit its motion prior, while its sparse query-based supervision alone provides a weaker signal for
learning geometry than the GFM-finetuned methods.
To narrow this gap, we propose a natural solution within our framework: by plugging in a pretrained video-depth adapter as a frozen geometry prior, we are able to reuse knowledge learned from dense depth estimation without a separate dense 3D pretraining stage.
blocks.zh:
最近的 GFM 图像化的 4D 感知器 (Sucar等人,2026年;Luo等人,2026年;Lin等人,2026年)受益于几何学前科,通过大规模密集的3D预训学习.
与此相反,GEN4P调整了预先训练的视频生成器,以先利用其运动,而仅其零星的基于查询的监管则为
学习几何学比 GFM 纤维化方法。
为了缩小这一差距,我们提出了我们框架内的自然解决方案:通过插入一个预先经过训练的视频深度适配器作为冷冻的几何前置,我们能够重新利用从密集深度估计中获取的知识,而无需单独进行密集的3D预训阶段.

we adopt a plug-in geometry prior from a pretrained video depth estimation model,
DVD ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , which is also built upon Wan2.1.
We combine the pretrained Depth-LoRA ( Δ ​ W Depth \Delta W_{\mathrm{Depth}} ) with our 4D-LoRA ( Δ ​ W 4 ​ D \Delta W_{\mathrm{4D}} ) (Sec. 3.2.1 ), forming a double-LoRA architecture.

Lightweight Training. Following prior work on retaining pretrained adapters during task adaptation ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , we freeze the VAE encoder, W DiT W_{\mathrm{DiT}} and Δ ​ W Depth \Delta W_{\mathrm{Depth}} ,
and jointly optimize Δ ​ W 4 ​ D \Delta W_{\mathrm{4D}} , the query embeddings, the query decoder, and the prediction head. Thus, the pretrained depth update is retained while a separate update is learned for 4D perception under the task objective.
We point out that the double-LoRA variant requires no additional dense prediction head and has the same number of trainable parameters as the variant using 4D-LoRA alone.
In Sec. 4.5 , we compare several adaptation strategies,
providing empirical support for our design.

Data Usage. We distinguish two types of input frames: encoder frames , which are input to the encoder to extract scene tokens, and query frames , which provide local RGB patches for decoder queries.
They share the same aspect ratio but may differ in resolution.
Encoder frames are maximally center-cropped to one of five predefined aspect ratios and uniformly resized to the largest resolution within a 480 × 832 480\times 832 bound,
while query frames generally retain their original resolution.
To speed up training,
we use ℰ VAE \mathcal{E}_{\text{VAE}} to pre-encode all video clips into latents and discard the VAE during training.

它们具有相同的比例,但分辨率可能不同。

We also apply temporal augmentation to handle varying motion speeds.
To this end,
each raw video is subsampled into 49-frame clips with temporal intervals ranging from 1 to 4. During training, we randomly slice the first 21 ∼ 49 21\sim 49 frames in steps of 4, and head-truncate the video latent accordingly.
We also apply downsizing-only spatial augmentation to the query frames, so that the model sees a variety of query-patch fields of view.
See Secs. B.1 and B.2 for more details about datasets and data preprocessing & sampling, respectively.

Architecture. We evaluate two adaptation variants.
The basic variant,
denoted as ‘Ours’,

The double-LoRA variant,
denoted as ‘Ours- II ’,
additionally incorporates geometry priors through the frozen rank-512 Depth-LoRA, Δ ​ W Depth 512 \Delta W_{\mathrm{Depth}}^{512} ( Sec. 3.3 ).
Both variants have 0.70 0.70 B trainable encoder parameters.
We use an 8-block cross-attention decoder, which has 0.18 0.18 B trainable parameters.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We present Gen4P,
a feed-forward 4D perceiver that processes monocular video input for full 4D reconstruction.
The key to its success is to leverage prior knowledge from pretrained video generators in a single-step manner,
which differs from traditional multi-step denoising-based 4D perceivers.
Our on-demand decoder enables flexible spatial and temporal querying, while a frozen video-depth LoRA provides a plug-in geometry prior without additional trainable parameters.
Crucially,
we demonstrate that Gen4P achieves state-of-the-art and flexible 4D reconstruction,
with future improvement expected as video generative pretraining continues to advance.
We also demonstrate its capability to accurately capture dynamic motion and intricate details in real-world videos.
Together, these findings support video generators as a promising foundation for unified 4D reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍Gen4P,
一个向导的 4D 感应器,用于处理用于完整 4D 重建的 单极视频输入。
成功的关键是用单步方式利用经过预先训练的视频生成器的事先知识,
它不同于传统的多步骤去诺的4D感知器。
我们的点播解码器可以灵活地进行空间和时间查询,而冷冻的视频深度LORA则提供插件几何学,而不增加可训练参数。
关键是
我们证明Gen4P实现了最先进和灵活的4D重建,
随着视频基因预训的继续推进,预计未来将有所改善。
我们还表明,它有能力在现实世界的视频中准确记录动态运动和复杂细节。
这些调查结果共同支持视频发电机成为统一的4D重建的有希望的基础.

blocks.en: B.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: B.1 数据集

blocks.en: We distinguish two types of input frames: encoder frames , which are fed to the encoder to extract scene tokens, and query frames , from which local RGB patches are extracted to construct decoder queries. The two share the same aspect ratio but may differ in spatial resolution.
blocks.zh: 我们区分两种类型的输入帧:编码器帧,它们被输入编码器以提取场景符号;查询帧,从中提取本地的RGB补丁以构造解码器查询. 两者具有相同的侧面比,但空间分辨率可能有所不同。

blocks.en: For encoder frames, each raw video is maximally center-cropped to one of five predefined aspect ratios. The cropped frames are then uniformly resized to the largest resolution within a 480 × 832 480\times 832 bound, resulting in five encoder frame sizes: 480 × 480 480\times 480 , 480 × 640 480\times 640 , 480 × 832 480\times 832 , 352 × 832 352\times 832 , and 256 × 832 256\times 832 . The corresponding query frames use the same cropped content before resizing, and their resolutions therefore depend on the native resolution of each dataset.
blocks.zh: 对于编码器帧,每个原始视频被最大程度的中-croptropt到五个预定义的宽度比之一. 之后在480×832 480\时装832绑定内统一调整成最大的分辨率,形成5个编码框尺寸:480×480\时装480,480×640480×时装640,480×832480×时装832,352×352×时装832,256×832256×时装832. 相应的查询框架在重新调整大小之前使用相同的裁剪内容,因此其分辨率取决于每个数据集的原生分辨率.

During training, datasets are sampled according to the probabilities reported in the final column. In practice, we tolerate a slight distortion between them.

blocks.en: To vary the effective field of view of query patches, we apply downsizing-only augmentation to the query frames. For each training clip, we first resize them within a 960 × 1664 960\times 1664 bound, then sample a side length scale factor from [ 0.5 , 1.0 ] [0.5,1.0] , and resize all query frames by the same factor. This augmentation is applied only to the query frames for the decoder, while the pre-encoded latents remain unchanged.
blocks.zh: 为了改变查询补丁的有效视图领域,我们对查询框架只应用缩小的增强. 对于每一个训练片段,我们首先在960×1664 960\times 1664绑定内调整它们的大小,然后从[0.5,1.0][0.5,1.0]中抽取一个侧长度尺度因子,然后用相同的因子调整所有查询帧的大小. 这种增强仅适用于解码器的查询框架,而预编码的潜伏则保持不变.

blocks.en: Frame and Query Sampling. Since the Wan-VAE uses causal temporal convolutions, the latent at each timestamp doesn’t encode future RGB frames and thus can be safely head-truncated. Its encoding is first-frame anchored: the first latent corresponds to the first RGB frame, while each subsequent latent encodes four additional RGB frames. Thus, for T = 4 ​ N + 1 T=4N+1 , we slice the first T T query frames and the first N + 1 N+1 latent frames. In practice, we randomly sample the query clip length from { 21 , 25 , … , 49 } \{21,25,\ldots,49\} . A too-short clip will fail to provide adequate context for motion learning and lead to a performance drop.
blocks.zh: 框架和查询样本。 因为Wan-VAE使用因果时间演化, 它的编码是第一帧锚定的:第一个潜伏的对应第一个RGB帧,而随后的每一个潜伏的编码又增加了四个RGB帧. 因此,对于T = 4 N + 1 T = 4N + 1,我们切除第一个 T T T 查询帧和第一个 N + 1 N + 1 潜在帧. 在实际操作中,我们随机抽取来自 { 21, 25,..., 49} 的查询剪辑长度 { 21, 25,\ ldots, 49} 。 短片将无法为运动学习提供足够的背景,导致性能下降。

blocks.en: During training, we sample at most 2048 queries per training clip, with t src t_{\mathrm{src}} independently sampled for each query. Temporally, we enforce t tgt = t cam t_{\mathrm{tgt}}=t_{\mathrm{cam}} for 40 % 40\% of the queries, while the rest are randomly sampled. Spatially, 40 % 40\% is sampled from the foreground and 10 % 10\% is sampled from the foreground boundaries marked by Sobel-filtered depth maps.

blocks.en: B.3 Regarding Aria Digital Twin (ADT)
blocks.zh: B.3 关于阿里亚数字双胞胎

blocks.en: We include ADT ( Pan et al., 2023 ) in our training data because recent Geometry Foundation Models (GFMs) such as VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) and DA3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) include ADT for geometry training, while subsequent GFM-based 4D perception methods ( Sucar et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) build upon these pretrained models. We therefore include ADT to provide comparable geometric supervision during training.
blocks.zh: 我们把ADT(Pan等人,2023年)列入我们的培训数据,因为最近的几何学基础模型,如VGGT(Wang等人,2025年a)和DA3(Lin等人,2025年)包括了ADT用于几何学培训,而后来的基于GFM的4D感知方法(Sucar等人,2026年;Luo等人,2026年;Lin等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年)则以这些经过预先训练的模型为基础。 因此,我们把会计和报告司包括在内,以便在培训期间提供类似的几何监督。

blocks.en: Since ADT does not provide an official train-test split like DR or PO, to ensure a legal training, we strictly EXCLUDE all sequences used by the WorldTrack-ADT benchmark from our training set, as shown in Tab. A2 .
blocks.zh: 由于ADT没有像DR或PO那样提供正式的列车测试,以确保法律培训,因此我们严格地说,EXCLUDE是WorldTrack-ADT基准从我们的培训组合中使用的所有序列,如Tab所示. A2 (英语).

blocks.en: And as shown in Tab. A3 , including ADT in training overall improves tracking performance on the held-out ADT and PO, while performance on the remaining benchmarks stays consistent.
blocks.zh: 如塔布所示. A3,在培训中包括会计处理司,总体改进了对被搁置的会计处理司和PO的跟踪业绩,而其余基准的业绩则保持不变。

blocks.en: Motion Threshold. ADT, DR and PO contain both static and dynamic tracks, whereas PS contains only dynamic tracks. To reliably distinguish dynamic points from static ones for evaluation, we need to select an appropriate motion threshold that suppresses numerical noise in static GT tracks while preserving dynamic tracks with small motions.

blocks.en: We measure the motion of each GT track by accumulating adjacent-frame 3D displacements over 64 frames in meters. As shown in Tab. A4 , increasing the threshold from 5 × 10 − 3 → 1 × 10 − 2 5\times 10^{-3}\to 1\times 10^{-2} changes the average static ratio only marginally from 56.82 % → 57.29 % 56.82\%\to 57.29\% , indicating that 5 × 10 − 3 5\times 10^{-3} is adequate for removing the majority of the numerical noise.

In contrast, increasing the threshold from 5 × 10 − 3 → 5 × 10 − 2 5\times 10^{-3}\to 5\times 10^{-2} may lead to noticeably more wrongly classified static tracks. The static ratio on ADT shows 67.23 % → 74.30 % 67.23\%\to 74.30\% , a non-negligible 7.07 % 7.07\% , while on PStudio, despite being fully dynamic, increases to 2.00 % 2.00\% .

blocks.en: We therefore use 5 × 10 − 3 5\times 10^{-3} as the dynamic-motion threshold throughout our world-coordinate tracking evaluation.
